notes: Four waws against three ands: the group-boundary waw before seven hundred is the surplus one and goes unrepresented (rule 42).
threescore and fifteen recasts Hebrew five and seventy; the two Hebrew numerals are kept in one noncompositional unit, discontinuous around the waw's and, rather than paired off arbitrarily.
The anarthrous substantive pequdei takes of them that were numbered, headed on the lexeme-bearing numbered (rules 46, 19, 20).
